control_patch:
# Deliberate-breakage control checker for the W01 observables (applied to a COPY of the tree):
#  B1 failure kind: the stake classifier tests TriesToUnstake before TriesToStake, and the tx
#     classifier reports NonceTooLarge for every nonce failure;
#  B2 per-outcome compute: a transaction outcome reports gas burnt + 1 compute;
#  B3 attribution: every key first committed in a step counts as changed (pre-state comparison dropped).
import sys, os
root = sys.argv[1]
def rep(p, old, new):
    p = os.path.join(root, p); s = open(p).read(); assert s.count(old) == 1, (p, old); open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
fk = 'spec/lean/v3/NearSpecV3/Successor/FailureKinds.lean'
rep(fk, '''      if x.amount < stake - x.locked then "TriesToStake"
      else if x.locked == 0 && stake == 0 then "TriesToUnstake"''', '''      if x.locked == 0 && stake == 0 then "TriesToUnstake"
      else if x.amount < stake - x.locked then "TriesToStake"''')
rep(fk, '''  if !(if strict then cur + 1 < two64 && txNonce == cur + 1 else txNonce > cur) then some "InvalidNonce"''',
        '''  if !(if strict then cur + 1 < two64 && txNonce == cur + 1 else txNonce > cur) then some "NonceTooLarge"''')
se = 'spec/lean/v3/NearSpecV3/Successor/StorageExecution.lean'
rep(se, '''    let cu := rs1.compute - rs0.compute''', '''    let cu := rs1.compute - rs0.compute + 1''')
rep(se, '''  (sortKV known, sortKV unknown)''', '''  (sortKV all, [])''')
print('control applied')
